design.approach: Three layers mapped to the finding's recommendation. Layer 1 (host continuation): a deterministic decision core plus an opencode session.idle plugin that re-enters a CSM run while the guard reports work, bounded, off by default, and pilot-gated. Layer 2 (durable cursor is the driver): a plan-record completion-evidence predicate that rejects status-only bulk completion, wired fail-closed into the lineage gate, plus a resumable agent-session timeout. Layer 3 (completion contract): additive csm-plan/2 completionContract, continuationPolicy, and task executionReceipt, required by csm-plan and consumed by csm-build as a mandatory close-out sequence.
design.dataFlow: session.idle -> plugin locates active run -> guard -> decideContinuation -> inject bounded continue or stop; plan close-out -> completion-evidence gate -> reject bulk completion.
interfaces: decideContinuation(record, guardResult, budget) -> { action: continue|pause|stop, reason, command }
